# Generation 2 Test and Runtime Evidence

The Awtsmoos asks not for confidence but witness; Awtsmoos.com records the measured trail so another developer can distinguish proof from wish.

## Static evidence

- Focused regression tests pass: artifact freshness/privacy, public static metadata parsing, HTML SEO enrichment/preservation, comment sitemap fixtures, alias/comment/translation renderers.
- Every touched/new Generation-2 source and generated JS artifact remains at or below 120 lines.
- Generated artifact rebuild is byte-for-byte idempotent.
- `git diff --check` passes.
- Existing Heichel quality suite passes across 1,269 files.
- Existing route suite passes 135 required routes across 109 route files.

## Fresh real-data runtime evidence on port 8937

- `/apps/piano` returns 301 to `/apps/piano/`.
- `/apps/piano/` returns 200 with slash canonical, description, index/follow robots, and matching OpenGraph URL.
- App sitemap contains `https://awtsmoos.com/apps/piano/`.
- About, Docs, Social, Contact return 200 with canonical/description/indexable metadata.
- Docs description is exactly: `B'H — Learn, search, explore every API, project boundary, and Data/Security/Realtime system in Awtsmoos.com.`
- Core sitemap includes About/Contact/Docs/Social and excludes Login/Logout/Control/Donate.
- Comment sitemap returns 200 in about 0.59 seconds.
- Torah Road returns 200 with the server-rendered initial article intact.
- Six currently valid aliases all return 200; maximum observed profile latency is about 0.288 seconds.
- Current six aliases contain zero authored-post records in real data, so no real authored teaching link was available to follow; deterministic authored-post tests cover the future-data contract.
